name: Montana
agency: Montana Department of Justice, Motor Vehicle Division (MVD)
handbook_edition: Official Montana Driver Manual, revised October 2018 (copy hosted by the Montana Office of Public Instruction; mvdmt.gov blocks automated access, a Feb. 2025 Spanish edition exists there but could not be read). Values cross-checked against the Montana Code Annotated 2025.

permit_min_age_years.quote: The department may issue a learner license, which is valid for 1 year from the date of issuance, to any person who is at least 14 1/2 years of age and who has successfully completed or is successfully participating in a traffic education course
permit_min_age_years.note: 14½ only with an approved (school) traffic education course. 2018 manual: otherwise 'at least 16 years of age (without traffic education) or 15 years of age and successfully completed an approved driver education course'.

permit_holding_months.quote: (a) has held a learner license or traffic education permit for a period of not less than 6 months;

supervised_hours_total.quote: has successfully completed a traditional traffic education course ... that states that the person has had at least 50 hours of driving experience, 10 of which were at night
supervised_hours_total.note: With an alternative traffic education course approved by DOJ: 75 hours, 15 at night (MCA 61-5-132(1)(c)(ii)).

supervised_hours_night.quote: at least 50 hours of driving experience, 10 of which were at night
supervised_hours_night.note: 15 at night with the alternative course.

intermediate_min_age_years.quote: The department may not issue a license under this chapter to a person: (1) who is under 15 years of age unless the person is at least 13 years of age and, because of individual hardship
intermediate_min_age_years.note: First-year restricted license: earliest at 15 (learner at 14½ + 6 months). Derived from MCA 61-5-105, 61-5-106(2) and 61-5-132.

full_license_min_age_years.quote: A driver's license issued to a person who is under 18 years of age is subject to the following restrictions for 1 year from the date of issuance of the license or until the person is 18 years of age, whichever occurs first
full_license_min_age_years.note: Earliest 16 (restricted license at 15 + 1 year).

drivers_ed_required.value: Required for licensing under 18: an approved traffic education course (traditional or DOJ-approved alternative) per MCA 61-5-132
drivers_ed_required.quote: (c) (i) has successfully completed a traditional traffic education course approved pursuant to 20-7-503 (1) ... or (ii) has successfully completed an alternative traffic education course approved by the department of justice
drivers_ed_required.note: 2018 manual adds that online or third-party courses are not approved (may have changed with the 2021 'alternative course' amendment).

knowledge_test_questions.note: Not stated in any official source read; mvdmt.gov inaccessible (Cloudflare 403). Third-party sites say 33 questions, not accepted.

knowledge_test_pass_correct.note: Not confirmed on an official source.

knowledge_test_pass_percent.note: Not confirmed on an official source (third parties conflict: 80% vs 82%).

knowledge_test_retake_wait.quote: Driver license receipts are good for one year and three test attempts are permitted within that one-year period.
knowledge_test_retake_wait.note: No waiting period stated; OPI 2023 adapted manual says 3 attempts per one-year receipt.

knowledge_test_spanish.note: An official Spanish manual (rev. Feb 2025) is published on mvdmt.gov, but the site blocked access and no official text read confirms the test is offered in Spanish.

permit_fee_usd.quote: Any Class D basic license or a learner license listed.............................................................. $5.00 per year
permit_fee_usd.note: Learner license valid 1 year = $5, plus 3% administrative fee (2018 manual: 'Fees in this manual are subject to change').

license_fee_usd.quote: driver's license, except a commercial driver's license -- $5 a year or fraction of a year;
license_fee_usd.note: Per year. A license issued under 21 expires on the 21st birthday (MCA 61-5-111(4)(c)), so about $25-30 for a teen; plus MVD 3% administrative fee and REAL ID fee if chosen.

night_restriction.value: First-year restricted license (under 18): no driving 11 p.m. to 5 a.m. unless with a licensed driver 18+, or for work, school, religious events, emergencies, farm work, or parent authorization
night_restriction.quote: A restricted licensee may not operate a motor vehicle between the hours of 11 p.m. and 5 a.m. unless the restricted licensee is: (i) accompanied by a licensed driver who is 18 years of age or older

passenger_restriction.value: First 6 months: max 1 passenger under 18 (non-family) unless supervised by licensed driver 18+; next 6 months: max 3 passengers under 18
passenger_restriction.quote: For the first 6 months of the 1-year restriction period, a restricted licensee may not operate a motor vehicle with more than one passenger who is under 18 years of age unless
passenger_restriction.note: Second 6 months: 'more than three passengers who are under 18'.

teen_phone_ban.quote: Most Montana cities have passed laws against texting and talking on cell phones while driving.
teen_phone_ban.note: No statewide (teen or general) cellphone ban found in official sources; MCA 61-5-133 first-year restrictions contain no phone rule. Local ordinances apply.

under21_bac.quote: The BAC for a driver under 21 years of age is 0.02.

motorcycle_permit_min_age_years.quote: A motorcycle learner license is obtained by paying the licensing fee and passing the motorcycle written test.
motorcycle_permit_min_age_years.note: Minimum age for the motorcycle learner license not stated explicitly; general statutory floor is 15 (MCA 61-5-105), 14½ with traffic education.

motorcycle_test_questions.note: Not stated on official sources read.

motorcycle_test_pass.note: Not stated on official sources read.

name: Nebraska
agency: Nebraska Department of Motor Vehicles
handbook_edition: January 2025

permit_min_age_years.quote: Minimum Age 15 You may apply 60 days before 15th birthday. However, the Learner's Permit cannot be issued until the day of your 15th birthday
permit_min_age_years.note: Standard Learner's Permit (LPD). A School Learner's Permit (LPE) is available at 14 (manual 1C-2: 'Minimum Age: 14') for rural students eligible for a School Permit (SCP, from 14 years 2 months), which allows unsupervised driving to/from school only.

permit_holding_months.quote: Have held a School Learner's Permit (LPE), School Permit (SCP) or Learner's Permit (LPD) for at least six months and not accumulated three or more points

supervised_hours_total.quote: Complete a 50 hour certification form signed by a parent, guardian or licensed driver who is at least 21. The certification form must indicate that at least 10 hours of motor vehicle operation was between sunset and sunrise.
supervised_hours_total.note: Alternative: completing a DMV-approved driver safety course replaces the 50-hour certification.

supervised_hours_night.quote: at least 10 hours of motor vehicle operation was between sunset and sunrise

intermediate_min_age_years.quote: 16. You may apply 60 days before your 16th birthday, however the permit will not be issued until on or after your 16th birthday.
intermediate_min_age_years.note: Provisional Operator's Permit (POP).

full_license_min_age_years.quote: Minimum Age 17 ... Who have held a Provisional Operator's Permit (POP) for at least 12 months and who have not accumulated three or more points ... are eligible for an operator's license.
full_license_min_age_years.note: Earliest at 17 after 12 months on the POP with fewer than 3 points.

drivers_ed_required.value: Not required: a DMV-approved driver safety course OR a 50-hour supervised driving certification (10 at night) is required for the POP/School Permit
drivers_ed_required.quote: Successfully complete a Department of Motor Vehicles approved Nebraska driver safety course , or Complete a 50 hour certification form
drivers_ed_required.note: Completing the approved course also waives the written and drive tests.

knowledge_test_questions.note: Number of questions not stated in the official manual or on dmv.nebraska.gov pages read; third-party sites say 25 but that is not accepted.

knowledge_test_pass_correct.note: Not stated on an official source read.

knowledge_test_pass_percent.note: Not stated on an official source read (third-party: 80%).

knowledge_test_retake_wait.value: Not the same day (next day at the earliest)
knowledge_test_retake_wait.quote: Any test failed may not be retaken the same day.

knowledge_test_spanish.note: An official Spanish manual is published, but no official page read states that the written test itself is offered in Spanish.

permit_fee_usd.quote: Learner's Permit (LPD) Fees ... Original $8.00 $5.00 $13.00
permit_fee_usd.note: $8 fee + $5 security fee for the original LPD (valid 1 year).

license_fee_usd.quote: Operator's License (Class O) Fees ... Valid for 5 years $24.00 $5.00 $29.00
license_fee_usd.note: 5-year Class O ($24 + $5 security fee). A teen first gets the POP: $20 ($15 + $5).

night_restriction.value: POP: no unsupervised driving from midnight to 6 a.m. unless to/from home and work or a school activity
night_restriction.quote: Individual may only drive unsupervised between 12 midnight and 6 a.m. if they are driving to or from home to work or a school activity.

passenger_restriction.value: POP, first 6 months: no more than one passenger under 19 who is not an immediate family member
passenger_restriction.quote: During the first six months of the POP, the holder can only operate a motor vehicle with no more than one passenger who is not an immediate family member and who is under nineteen years of age.

teen_phone_ban.quote: Cell Phones – No use of any type of interactive wireless communication device while operating a motor vehicle while in motion.
teen_phone_ban.note: Listed among GDL restrictions (manual 1B).

under21_bac.quote: .02% Under Age Drinking (Age 20 and Younger) and Driving For a conviction of .02% the license will be impounded by the court for 30 days

motorcycle_permit_min_age_years.quote: The Learner's Permit (LPD) is issued to allow a person to legally practice driving for a Provisional Operator's Permit (POP) , Operator's (Class O) or Motorcycle (Class M) License. ... Minimum Age 15
motorcycle_permit_min_age_years.note: Rural students may get a Class M School Learner's Permit (LPE) at 14 (manual 1C-3).

motorcycle_test_questions.note: Not stated on official pages read.

motorcycle_test_pass.note: Not stated on official pages read.

name: Nevada
agency: Nevada Department of Motor Vehicles
handbook_edition: DMV 700, March 2024

permit_min_age_years.quote: Nevada residents can apply for an instruction permit at age 15½.

permit_holding_months.quote: If you are under the age of 18, you must hold an instruction permit for at least 6 months prior to applying for a driver license.

supervised_hours_total.quote: Nevada teens within a 30 miles of a DMV-approved driver's education school are required to complete 50 hours of supervised experience behind the wheel, 10 of which must be completed at night.
supervised_hours_total.note: Teens more than 30 miles from an approved school and without internet access for an online course must instead log 100 hours (10 in the dark). Logged on DMV form DLD-130.

supervised_hours_night.quote: 50 hours of supervised experience behind the wheel, 10 of which must be completed at night.

intermediate_min_age_years.quote: Applicants who are 16 or 17 years old when they receive their driver's license will not be allowed to carry passengers under the age of 18 (except for immediate family members) for the first 6 months
intermediate_min_age_years.note: Nevada has no separate provisional license class; minors receive a minor (vertical) license with restrictions. 15.5 + 6 months = 16.

full_license_min_age_years.quote: This curfew remains in effect until the driver turns 18, regardless of when the driver license was issued.
full_license_min_age_years.note: Passenger restriction ends after 6 months; curfew lasts until 18.

drivers_ed_required.value: Required for applicants under 18 (DMV-approved classroom or online course); if no approved school within 30 miles and no internet access, 100 hours of logged driving instead
drivers_ed_required.quote: you will be required to present a Certificate of Completion of a course in driver's education and a Beginning Driver Experience Log, DMV Form DLD-130.

knowledge_test_questions.quote: Test Format 25 Questions Multiple choice format 80% Passing Score 20 correct answers needed

knowledge_test_retake_wait.quote: If you fail, you can retake the test the next day. If you're disqualified, you can retake the test after 24 hours.
knowledge_test_retake_wait.note: Statement given for the online (KnowTo Drive) test; 'A $10 retest fee applies to all retakes.'

knowledge_test_spanish.quote: In-Person at DMV Offices Administered on touch-screen computers Available in English, Spanish, and audio format

permit_fee_usd.quote: Instruction Permit $22.50 ... Initial Knowledge and Skills Test $25 Each Retest $10
permit_fee_usd.note: Permit $22.50 plus a separate $25 initial knowledge/skills testing fee.

license_fee_usd.quote: Original 8-Year Non-Commercial License $41.50 ... Completion of Instruction Permit $22.50
license_fee_usd.note: A teen converting a permit pays the 'Completion of Instruction Permit' fee $22.50 (also on dmv.nv.gov/getdlteens.htm: 'Fee: $22.50'). An original 8-year non-commercial license is $41.50.

night_restriction.value: Drivers under 18: no driving between 10 p.m. and 5 a.m. unless going to/from a scheduled event (school or work)
night_restriction.quote: a minor shall not operate a motor vehicle between the hours of 10 p.m. and 5 a.m. unless he/she is driving to or from a scheduled event.

passenger_restriction.value: First 6 months of license (16-17): no passengers under 18 except immediate family
passenger_restriction.quote: For the first 6 months: No passengers under 18 (except immediate family)

teen_phone_ban.quote: The use of a cellular phone or other handheld wireless communications device to engage in voice communications is prohibited unless the device is used with a hands-free accessory.
teen_phone_ban.note: No teen-specific all-device ban found in official sources; the handheld ban applies to all drivers (hands-free allowed).

under21_bac.quote: 02 BAC limit for drivers under 21
under21_bac.note: Handbook: revoked 185 days if test shows at least 0.02% but less than 0.08%.

motorcycle_permit_min_age_years.quote: If you want an instruction permit for driving a motorcycle, you must: • Be at least 15½ years old;
motorcycle_permit_min_age_years.note: Also requires the general knowledge test plus the motorcycle knowledge test.

motorcycle_test_questions.quote: you must pass the written motorcycle knowledge test (25 questions, 80% passing score)

motorcycle_test_pass.quote: written motorcycle knowledge test (25 questions, 80% passing score)

name: New Hampshire
agency: New Hampshire Department of Safety, Division of Motor Vehicles
handbook_edition: DSMV 360, Rev. 11/25

permit_min_age_years.quote: New Hampshire does not issue learner's permits; however, a person learning to drive ... is permitted to drive under certain conditions ... The driver must be at least 15½ years old and must carry proof of age in the vehicle.
permit_min_age_years.note: NO learner's permit exists in NH: supervised practice driving (adult 25+, front seat) is allowed from 15½ with proof of age.

permit_holding_months.quote: New Hampshire residents can start learning to drive at the age of 15½ but must be at least 16 years old to apply for a driver license.
permit_holding_months.note: No permit, so no legal holding period; in practice 15½ to 16 = 6 months of possible practice.

supervised_hours_total.quote: each student must log forty (40) additional hours of supervised driving time with a parent, guardian, or other responsible adult prior to applying for a driver license.
supervised_hours_total.note: In addition to the 10 hours behind the wheel in driver education.

supervised_hours_night.quote: Included in the requirements for the forty (40) additional hours of supervised driving time is at least ten (10) hours to be completed at night.

intermediate_min_age_years.quote: Any person over 16 years old and under 21 years of age who meets the requirements for a New Hampshire driver license, will be issued a Youth Operator License.
intermediate_min_age_years.note: Youth Operator License (vertical), expires on 21st birthday.

full_license_min_age_years.quote: In addition to any other restrictions, the holder of a Youth Operator License who is under 18 years of age: Shall not operate a motor vehicle between the hours of 1:00 a.m. and 4:00 a.m.
full_license_min_age_years.note: Hour/passenger/phone restrictions apply under 18; the Youth Operator License itself (with stricter violation suspensions under 20) runs until 21.

drivers_ed_required.value: Required for all applicants under 18 (30 h classroom, 10 h behind the wheel, 6 h observation)
drivers_ed_required.quote: Persons under 18 years old must take an approved driver education program.

knowledge_test_questions.quote: The knowledge test consists of 40 multiple choice questions pertaining to the rules of the road and general driving conditions. Testers have 40 minutes to complete the test.

knowledge_test_pass_correct.quote: If more than 8 questions are answered incorrectly, the test will automatically end.

knowledge_test_pass_percent.quote: All knowledge exams require a passing grade of 80%.

knowledge_test_retake_wait.quote: Operator and Motorcycle applicants will have to wait ten (10) calendar days before they are allowed to retest

knowledge_test_spanish.quote: Knowledge tests are available in English, French, Spanish, Arabic, Mandarin, Portuguese, Farsi and American sign language

permit_fee_usd.quote: New Hampshire does not issue learner's permits
permit_fee_usd.note: Not applicable: no learner's permit, so no permit fee.

license_fee_usd.quote: Youth Operator $10.00 per year up to age 21
license_fee_usd.note: Per year until the 21st birthday (about $50 for a license issued at 16). Adult Operator license: $50 (non-REAL ID) / $60 REAL ID.

night_restriction.value: Youth operators under 18: no driving between 1:00 a.m. and 4:00 a.m.
night_restriction.quote: Shall not operate a motor vehicle between the hours of 1:00 a.m. and 4:00 a.m.

passenger_restriction.value: Under 18, first 6 months: no more than one passenger under 25 who is not family, unless accompanied by a licensed adult 25+
passenger_restriction.quote: Shall not operate a motor vehicle with more than one passenger less than 25 years of age who is not a member of the driver's family unless accompanied by a licensed, responsible adult who is at least 25 years of age during the first six (6) months holding the license.

teen_phone_ban.quote: Drivers under the age of 18 years of age shall not use a cellular or mobile telephone or other mobile electronic device, whether hands-free or not, while driving
teen_phone_ban.note: Emergency calls excepted.

under21_bac.quote: It is illegal for an operator under 21 years of age ... or while having an alcohol concentration 0.02 or more.

motorcycle_permit_min_age_years.quote: the DMV shall issue a motorcycle learner's permit to a New Hampshire resident 18 years of age or older or 16 years of age or older and under 18 years of age who has successfully completed an approved driver education course and has a valid New Hampshire driver's license.
motorcycle_permit_min_age_years.note: Under 18 must also complete a motorcycle Basic Rider Class. Permit fee $30, valid 45 days.

motorcycle_test_questions.note: Number of motorcycle knowledge test questions not stated on official pages read.

motorcycle_test_pass.quote: All knowledge exams require a passing grade of 80%.

name: New Jersey
agency: New Jersey Motor Vehicle Commission (NJMVC)
handbook_edition: 2026 (cover '2026', pages dated 4/9/26)

permit_min_age_years.quote: GDL: OPTION A STEP 1 Get a Special Learner Permit • Must be at least 16 years old ... • Must be enrolled in approved behind-the-wheel driver training course
permit_min_age_years.note: 16 = Special Learner Permit, only through an approved 6-hour behind-the-wheel course (instructor buys the permit). Without a driving school: Examination Permit at 17 (Option B).

permit_holding_months.quote: Must have completed six months of super-vised driving without any suspensions or postponements • Must pass the MVC's road test • Must be at least 17 years old

supervised_hours_total.quote: Must complete a minimum of 50 practice driving hours, including 10 hours during darkness
supervised_hours_total.note: Certified on a Certification of Supervised Driving form presented at licensure (Options A and B).

supervised_hours_night.quote: including 10 hours during darkness

intermediate_min_age_years.quote: STEP 3 Get a Probationary License ... • Must be at least 17 years old
intermediate_min_age_years.note: Probationary license.

full_license_min_age_years.quote: STEP 5 Get the Basic Driver License • Must be at least 18 years old • Must have completed one year of unsupervised driving with probationary driver license restrictions
full_license_min_age_years.note: Requires 1 year on the probationary license; probationary restrictions on hours/passengers/decals do not apply at 21+.

drivers_ed_required.value: Not required for the age-17 examination permit route; a 6-hour behind-the-wheel course is required only for the age-16 Special Learner Permit
drivers_ed_required.quote: An approved course is six full hours of behind-the-wheel instruction in a dual-controlled vehicle.

knowledge_test_questions.quote: The knowledge test consists of 50 questions: plus, a survey question about organ donation.

knowledge_test_pass_correct.quote: Written 80 percent, or 40 of the 50 questions, must have correct answers.

knowledge_test_pass_percent.quote: Written 80 percent, or 40 of the 50 questions, must have correct answers.

knowledge_test_retake_wait.note: No waiting period stated in the 2026 manual or the MVC knowledge-test page.

knowledge_test_spanish.quote: The written tests are offered in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (Mandarin), French, Spanish, ... Oral tests are offered in English and Spanish.

permit_fee_usd.quote: Probationary Automobile License ... Minimum Age: 17 (Permit: 16) Permit Fee: $10 + $4 Red reflectorized decals
permit_fee_usd.note: $10 permit plus $4 for the two mandatory red GDL decals (teen total $14).

license_fee_usd.quote: Basic Automobile License (Standard/REAL ID) ... Expiration: 4 Years ... License Fee(s): $24/$35
license_fee_usd.note: Basic license $24 standard / $35 REAL ID, valid 4 years. The same manual lists the Probationary Automobile License fee as '$63'.

night_restriction.value: Permit and probationary drivers under 21: no driving between 11:01 p.m. and 5:00 a.m. (work/religion exemptions)
night_restriction.quote: PROBATIONARY DRIVER LICENSE RESTRICTIONS No driving between 11:01 pm and 5:00 am

passenger_restriction.value: Permit and probationary: dependents plus one additional passenger, unless accompanied by a parent/guardian
passenger_restriction.quote: Passengers are limited to dependents of the probationary license holder and one additional person, unless accompanied by a parent/guardian.

teen_phone_ban.quote: No using hand-held or hands-free cell phones or any other electronic devices.
teen_phone_ban.note: Applies to special learner, examination permit and probationary license holders.

under21_bac.quote: younger than 21, it is illegal to drive with a BAC of 0.01 percent or higher.

motorcycle_permit_min_age_years.quote: Step 1: Get A Motorcycle Examination Permit ... • Must be at least 17 years old; parent/guardian consent required under age 18.
motorcycle_permit_min_age_years.note: Under 18 must take the MSEP Basic Rider Course; MVC road test without a course requires age 18.

motorcycle_test_questions.note: Not stated in the official manual.

motorcycle_test_pass.note: Not stated in the official manual.

name: New Mexico
agency: New Mexico Motor Vehicle Division (Taxation and Revenue Department)
handbook_edition: New Mexico Driver Manual ver. 11.19.19 (latest posted on MVD site)

permit_min_age_years.quote: The minimum age for an instructional permit is 15 years of age.
permit_min_age_years.note: Must be enrolled in or have completed an approved driver education course.

permit_holding_months.quote: The driver must retain the instructional permit for at least six months.

supervised_hours_total.quote: The driver must complete not less than 50 hours of practice driving, including not less than 10 hours of nighttime driving.

supervised_hours_night.quote: including not less than 10 hours of nighttime driving

intermediate_min_age_years.quote: The minimum age to receive a provisional license is 15 years and 6 months if the driver has held an instructional permit for 6 months.

full_license_min_age_years.quote: The driver must have held a provisional license for the 12- month period immediately preceding the date of application for a driver license.
full_license_min_age_years.note: Derived: provisional at 15.5 + 12 months = 16.5 earliest.

drivers_ed_required.value: Required under 18: TSB-approved driver education with a 3-hour DWI component.
drivers_ed_required.quote: Complete and pass a TSB “approved” ‘driver education’ program which includes a 3-hour DWI component
drivers_ed_required.note: Applicants 18-24 have separate rules (not covered). Page read via Wayback Machine copy (web.archive.org) of the official MVD page because mvd.newmexico.gov blocks automated access.

knowledge_test_questions.note: Not confirmed on an official source.

knowledge_test_pass_correct.note: Not confirmed on an official source.

knowledge_test_pass_percent.quote: All class D and M written test scores must be 70% or better to pass.
knowledge_test_pass_percent.note: MVD Driver Procedures Manual, chapter 11. Page read via Wayback Machine copy (web.archive.org) of the official MVD page because mvd.newmexico.gov blocks automated access.

knowledge_test_retake_wait.note: Not confirmed on an official source.

knowledge_test_spanish.quote: Knowledge exams are available in English, Spanish, Tagalog, Italian, German, French, Vietnamese, and Chinese.
knowledge_test_spanish.note: Page read via Wayback Machine copy (web.archive.org) of the official MVD page because mvd.newmexico.gov blocks automated access.

permit_fee_usd.quote: Instructional Permit – $10.00
permit_fee_usd.note: Page read via Wayback Machine copy (web.archive.org) of the official MVD page because mvd.newmexico.gov blocks automated access.

license_fee_usd.quote: Provisional License – $18.00Full-Unrestricted License – 4-year license is $18.00; 8-year license is $34.00
license_fee_usd.note: Teen first license = provisional $18; full unrestricted 4-year $18 / 8-year $34. Page read via Wayback Machine copy (web.archive.org) of the official MVD page because mvd.newmexico.gov blocks automated access.

night_restriction.value: Provisional: no driving midnight-5 a.m. unless with licensed driver 21+; exceptions for school, work, family/medical need, religious functions.
night_restriction.quote: The driver may not operate a motor vehicle upon public highways between the hours of midnight and 5:00 AM.

passenger_restriction.value: Provisional: no more than one passenger under 21 who is not immediate family, unless a licensed driver 21+ is in the vehicle.
passenger_restriction.quote: you may not have more than one other passenger under the age of 21 who is not a member of your immediate family in the vehicle.

teen_phone_ban.note: Not confirmed on an official source.

under21_bac.quote: In New Mexico, if you are under 21, you also can be arrested for BAC at .02%.

motorcycle_permit_min_age_years.note: Not confirmed on an official source.

motorcycle_test_questions.note: Not confirmed on an official source.

motorcycle_test_pass.quote: All class D and M written test scores must be 70% or better to pass.
motorcycle_test_pass.note: Page read via Wayback Machine copy (web.archive.org) of the official MVD page because mvd.newmexico.gov blocks automated access.

name: New York
agency: New York State Department of Motor Vehicles
handbook_edition: MV-21 Driver's Manual (current PDF on dmv.ny.gov, read 2026-10; no edition date printed in extracted text)

permit_min_age_years.quote: New York State residents 16 and older can apply for a New York learner permit.

permit_holding_months.quote: Your permit must be held, in valid status for a minimum of six months in order to take the road test.

supervised_hours_total.quote: your parent or guardian certifies that you completed at least 50 hours of practice driving, including at least 15 hours after sunset
supervised_hours_total.note: Certified on form MV-262 for under-18 road test.

supervised_hours_night.quote: at least 50 hours of practice driving, including at least 15 hours after sunset

intermediate_min_age_years.quote: Junior Operator, Class DJ - Minimum age is 16. ... Your permit must be held, in valid status for a minimum of six months in order to take the road test.
intermediate_min_age_years.note: Class DJ minimum age is 16 but the 6-month permit holding period (permit from 16) means the junior license comes at 16.5 at the earliest (derived).

full_license_min_age_years.quote: Operator, Class D - Minimum age is 18, or age 17 with a driver education Certificate of Completion
full_license_min_age_years.note: 17 with approved driver education (MV-285 certificate); otherwise junior restrictions apply until 18.

drivers_ed_required.value: Not required; a 5-hour pre-licensing course (or a driver education course) is required before the road test. Driver education allows the senior Class D license at 17.
drivers_ed_required.quote: Before you can make a road test appointment, you must first complete an approved safe driver course. This requirement is automatically fulfilled as part of every high school or college driver education course.

knowledge_test_questions.quote: To pass the written test, you must correctly answer at least 14 of the 20 questions asked, but you must correctly answer two of the four questions about road signs.

knowledge_test_pass_correct.quote: you must correctly answer at least 14 of the 20 questions asked, but you must correctly answer two of the four questions about road signs.
knowledge_test_pass_correct.note: Also at least 2 of the 4 road-sign questions.

knowledge_test_pass_percent.quote: you must correctly answer at least 14 of the 20 questions asked
knowledge_test_pass_percent.note: 14/20 = 70% (computed).

knowledge_test_retake_wait.note: Not confirmed on an official source.

knowledge_test_spanish.quote: The test is given in an easy-to-use format and is offered in English and Spanish.
